headline.text: L3 ML4 molds hit guard rail creating *debris throughout* — 20 molds pulled for inspection, demolding area cleaned.

summary: One active hold (L1 S2 film breaking continuously). L3 ML4 mold debris event resolved same shift; L1 S2 found Hershey product in Z-conveyor during changeover, areas inspected and cleared. L3 ML4 Level 3 cleaning incomplete at shift end — gondola visible soiling flagged.

holds.title: Film rolls breaking — QC hold
holds.summary: S2 film rolls (item 40338 v2) breaking continuously during SRS run; QC placed on hold at 13:43.
holds.status: On hold pending QC disposition; changeover to BUC completed.

food_safety.title: ML4 mold damage — debris throughout line
food_safety.summary: Molds hitting black guard rail damaged molds and created debris throughout demolding area; maintenance fixed rail, team removed 20 molds for inspection and cleaned area before restart.
food_safety.status: Resolved — guard rail repaired, 20 molds pulled, demolding area cleaned, production resumed.

food_safety.title: S4 burnt caramel scrapped
food_safety.summary: Caramel from 14:30 dark and smells burnt after kitchen pressure issues; scrapped and started fresh batch.
food_safety.status: Resolved — caramel scrapped, fresh batch started, line running.

food_safety.title: S2 product in Z-conveyor during changeover
food_safety.summary: Hershey product found in white Z-conveyor cover when switching to PRS; team inspected all areas including Cavannas and removed anything that could compromise product.
food_safety.status: Resolved — all areas inspected and cleared, PRS production started 20:47.

quality.title: S4 Theegarten damage from height rail adjustment
quality.summary: Height rail adjusted yesterday allowing oversized pieces into Theegarten, damaging machine; all rails moved back to paint lines, three stations of fold fingers and knife film guide repaired.
quality.status: Resolved — rails corrected to paint lines, repairs complete, centerline updated to reflect correct settings.

quality.title: S4 high flow-wrap reject rate
quality.summary: High number of open wrappers and flow-wrap rejects; caramel edges stiff enough to puncture film after tunnel cooling adjustment.
quality.status: Ongoing — adjusting length and cooling to reduce punctures.

quality.title: S4 oversize rejects at checkweigher
quality.summary: Many rejects at 17.8g due to high caramel measure; team adjusting.
quality.status: Ongoing — piece weight being dialed in.

quality.title: FFS open bags and weight loss
quality.summary: Line down for open bags at 09:55; maintenance adjusted long seal bar; later saw many bags with weight loss, knife cleaned.
quality.status: Resolved — seal bar adjusted, knife cleaned, line running well.

quality.title: ML1 water buffer temp outside setpoint
quality.summary: Water buffer tank temperature 43°F (outside setpoint), chocolate 38°F; team aware.

quality.title: ML1 mixed display versions
quality.summary: Line received with mixed displays of different versions; QA notified, team separating versions.
quality.status: Open — QA engaged, versions being separated.

quality.title: ML1 pre-treatment out of range
quality.summary: Pre-treatment weight out of range at startup; team aware.

quality.title: S4 valve seal leaking caramel
quality.summary: Valve seal YS140/23 leaking caramel; replacement requested.

quality.title: S3 jar orientation — 4 pallets rework
quality.summary: Jars not facing outward on many pallets; 4 pallets identified for rework per SafetyChain requirement.
quality.status: Resolved — 4 pallets reworked in ~2 hours, team coached on correct placement.

sanitation.title: ML4 TG4 wrap residue after marked complete
sanitation.summary: TG4 marked complete by 2nd shift but still has wrap residue visible at 12:13.
sanitation.status: Open — flagged to QA and maintenance.

sanitation.title: ML4 Level 3 cleaning incomplete at shift end
sanitation.summary: Level 3 cleaning gondola and cross-conveyor gondola allergen cleaning pending — visible soiling noted, not handed over to afternoon shift.

opportunities.text: Review equipment adjustment authorization on S4 — yesterday's unauthorized height rail change caused Theegarten damage and three stations of repairs.
Consider adding guard rail position check to ML4 startup checklist — today's mold damage and debris echo similar mechanical interference risks.
Review Level 3 cleaning handoff procedures for ML4 — today's incomplete gondola cleaning with visible soiling was not communicated to next shift.
